name: Depth of Field
description: A grid of image cards where the one under the pointer stays sharp and the rest blur with distance, like depth of field.

props.name: cards
props.type: { title: string; subtitle?: string; src: string; alt?: string; href?: string }[]
props.description: The cards. A card with href is a link; one without is a focusable figure so keyboard users can reach its caption.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns at full width. The grid follows its container's width and uses fewer columns when narrow.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the outer element, which is a size container.
